verdict.rationale: Mesh has a documented IAM roles API whose endpoints are gated by named permissions such as "View roles in account" and "Monitor and unmonitor customers". API credentials can also be given configurable permissions under Access Management. This shows a role- and permission-based access model, but the evidence never shows roles restricting case investigation actions (assignment, case decisions) or admin settings to specific user roles. Missing for 10: documentation of creating or assigning custom user roles, evidence that case review and decision actions can be restricted by role, coverage of admin-action restrictions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
